candidate_records.name: Abraham House
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010177 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay four-storey house over raised basement, built c.1820. The NIAH describes yellow Flemish-bond brick, a chamfered granite plinth, a partly rebuilt third floor, diminishing gauged flat-arched windows, replacement timber sashes, an original basement window and grille, and an engaged Ionic doorcase with fluted frieze. A modern marble plaque bears the inscription 'ABRAHAM HOUSE'. The appraisal identifies the house as part of the significant Gardiner Street Lower Georgian streetscape.

candidate_records.name: The Glen
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010179 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay four-storey house over raised basement, built c.1820. The NIAH records yellow Flemish-bond brick, a painted chamfered granite plinth, diminishing window openings, replacement timber sashes, cast-iron balconettes, an Ionic doorcase and stained-glass fanlight bearing the legend 'The Glen'. A large five-storey apartment block fronting Mabbot Lane occupies much of the rear site. The appraisal notes the paired-doorcase rhythm of Gardiner Street Lower.

candidate_records.name: Hazelbrook House
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010180 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay four-storey house over raised basement, built c.1820. The NIAH records yellow Flemish-bond brick, a moulded granite plinth, an Ionic doorcase, granite approach and cast-iron railings, plus a roof-lit two-storey warehouse mews building fronting Mabbot Lane. Nos.85 and 86 were adapted for use as one guesthouse, with openings inserted through their party wall at all levels; original staircases remain in both, and No.85 retains an original ground-floor fireplace. The two NIAH registrations must remain distinct despite shared operation and internal connections.

candidate_records.name: Hazelbrook House
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010181 present in Dublin missing-registration queue.
candidate_records.research_notes: Terraced two-bay four-storey house over raised basement, built c.1820. The NIAH records red Flemish-bond brick, a moulded granite plinth and string course over dressed limestone basement, cast-iron balconettes, an Ionic doorcase, granite approach and railings. The rear plot is built up with connected buildings and a roof-lit two-storey warehouse mews building fronting Mabbot Lane. Nos.85 and 86 were modified for use as a single guesthouse, with openings through their party wall at all levels; No.86 retains an original staircase and an original interior timber door with moulded surround and cobweb fanlight.

spatial_and_identity_cautions: Nos.82 and 83 are separately registered houses. Their shared granite-capped basement party wall and access arrangement are physical relationships, not a single registration.

No.84 is a separate registration; the large apartment block on Mabbot Lane is a rear-site structure described by NIAH and must not be conflated with the street-front Georgian house or duplicated without separate registration and footprint evidence.
Nos.85 and 86 are separately registered houses, although the NIAH records that they were internally connected and used as one guesthouse at survey time. Do not merge their individual registrations.

The roof-lit warehouse mews on Mabbot Lane is described as part of the built-up rear plots of Nos.85 and 86. Do not create an additional object without a separate registration or independent object-level evidence.
Individual NIAH page coordinate pairs are preserved as raw values because the page does not label their CRS. Do not interpret them as EPSG:2157 or overwrite official CSV coordinates.
NIAH descriptions of use, condition and alterations are survey-time source statements, not present-day field verification.
No physical access, ownership, public access or current condition has been verified.
